What guests mention

What guests mention most

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Carpaccio, foie gras, veal cheeks

7 Google reviews mention the carpaccio, 6 the foie gras and 6 the veal cheeks. One guest calls the carpaccio, foie gras, veal cheeks and desserts a piece of heaven.

Fish and fine dining

16 reviews mention fine dining, 10 the fish and 4 the wine list. One guest attended a food and wine pairing event and writes that the chef carefully prepared the menu.

Dishes for every diet

One guest writes that, for a group of three vegans and three meat eaters, the chef himself made the most amazing dishes.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Attentive service

One guest writes about immaculate service in a quiet place with pleasant music. Another calls the waiters attentive and very friendly.

Under the trees

One guest describes the location and atmosphere as very nice under the trees, with little lights on the tables.

Lunch or dinner

One guest came for a lovely afternoon lunch with music and atmosphere, shaded in a beautiful area. Another calls it one of the best dinners they had in Cyprus.

What guests say

Three of 256 Google reviews, 198 of them with five stars.

“One of the best and most tasty dinners we’ve had in Cyprus. My husband had a steak, which was perfectly tender. Location and atmosphere very nice under the trees with little lights on the tables. Waiters attentive and very friendly. We will definitely be back!”

Google review
“This was a wonderful experience. Amazing food and immaculate service in a quiet place with pleasant music. Carpaccio, foie gras, veal cheeks and deserts were a piece of Heaven.”

Google review
“We arrived straight from our wedding. It was such a wonderful surprise. We were three vegans and three meat eaters and the chef himself made us the most amazing dishes! We highly recommend coming and enjoying this gourmet food”
